mintAuthority.summary: USDRIF's two current native Rootstock minters are continuously collateral-accounted RIF and DOC V3 buckets, but Governor-authorized changers or role admins can grant MINTER_ROLE to an arbitrary address whose token mint has no collateral or numeric cap check. D14 is unbounded with continuous reconciliation. MOC governance supports early acceptance and immediate changer execution, so no unavoidable 48-hour delay is certified. Arbitrum OFT and Rootstock adapter powers remain assessed only under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: RIF On Chain V3 RIF collateral bucket
controls.capDescription: The bucket can mint USDRIF only through its collateralized operation path, bounded by deposited RIF, coverage thresholds, oracle pricing, and shared multi-collateral rules.
controls.evidence: At Rootstock block 9157327 on 2026-08-16, getRoleMemberCount(MINTER_ROLE) and BURNER_ROLE enumeration on the USDRIF token reported this official V3 MocCore bucket as one of exactly two members. Current RIF bucket collateral was 306,803,933.9926229 RIF; its protocol coverage and collateralized operation path bound user-initiated minting, while governance can change parameters or logic.

controls.label: RIF On Chain MOC token-vote governance
controls.capDescription: Accepted MOC-holder proposals can authorize changer contracts that alter mint parameters, roles, or UUPS implementations; no immutable numeric supply ceiling applies.
controls.evidence: At Rootstock block 9157327, the current governance path still resolves Governor 0x3b8853... to VotingMachine 0x65a568..., while VotingMachine names that Governor as its controlled governor. MOC stakers submit pre-votes and token-weighted votes through VotingMachine; accepted proposals call the controlled Governor, which authorizes the proposal's changer contract. Registry reads at block 9077990 report a 100,000 MOC proposal stake, 5% pre-vote winner threshold, 20% quorum, 50% acceptance threshold, 30% veto threshold, and a seven-day ordinary voting period; the contract also permits early acceptance at its configured high-support threshold, so no hard seven-day execution delay is claimed. The verified VotingMachine source executes an accepted proposal by calling controlledGovernor.executeChange; these governance parameters constrain proposals that can authorize mint changes or upgrades.

review.evidence: Current Rootstock block 9157327 reads enumerate the two and only two direct USDRIF MINTER_ROLE and BURNER_ROLE members: the RIF and DOC V3 collateral buckets. Their operation paths mint exclusively against protocol-accounted collateral, so native supply reconciliation is continuous by construction. The same block resolves the native UUPS implementation and Governor. The recursive governance chain remains: Governor 0x3b8853... is owned by VotingMachine 0x65a568..., Governor and VotingMachine proxies share ProxyAdmin 0x1a1824..., ProxyAdmin owner() is UpgradeDelegator proxy 0x131564..., and verified UpgradeDelegator implementation 0x6d1cca... gates upgrade(), upgradeAndCall(), and changeProxyAdmin() through Governor.isAuthorizedChanger with no keyholder bypass. Arbitrum OFT mint/burn and Rootstock adapter/OFT-owner administration are bridge controls retained under Bridge Risk and do not enter this native inventory. Native issuance remains partially-bounded-admin, raiseable, continuously reconciled, and unsupervised. D14/D29 sweep 2026-10-03 supersedes the historical raiseable classification: at Rootstock block 9293830 (hash 0x8f77258c9cfba3d0da535f26b47e1de9060951f7656ba25946725fdc3b160a41), the token implementation remains 0x6d1bb87856a2b2351d87ba5772a93dc911325af9. Verified MocRC20.grantRole accepts a Governor-authorized changer OR the role admin and can add an arbitrary MINTER_ROLE holder; mint(to,amount) checks only MINTER_ROLE, without collateral or a numeric cap. Enumeration confirms two current minters, RIF bucket 0xa27024ed70035e46dba712609fc2afa1c97aa36a and DOC bucket 0x697535055aa7afd2c280523c7b062b1f05284661, and one DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member, the RIF bucket. Bucket issuance remains continuously collateral-accounted, but role expansion makes D14 unbounded. D29 fails the unavoidable-delay gate: verified VotingLib._isAccepted accepts high-support proposals before voting expiry and VotingMachine.acceptedStep executes the changer immediately. Separate preVoteStep/voteStep calls impose no elapsed-time floor. Voting stakes are locked, but complete role-admin/bucket/governance executionScope closure and a 172800-second minimum are not certified. Fallback is unbounded-reconciled; bridge powers remain excluded.
